annotation.title_clean: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government (OMB Memorandum M-25-22)
annotation.title_en: Driving Efficient Acquisition of Artificial Intelligence in Government (OMB Memorandum M-25-22)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President (Russell T. Vought, Director)
annotation.summary_en: OMB Memorandum M-25-22 (April 2025) sets requirements for US federal agencies acquiring AI, replacing M-24-18. It covers cross-functional acquisition teams, vendor lock-in protections, IP and government data rights, privacy, testing and monitoring, and high-impact AI disclosures, and encourages buying American AI. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Rescinds and replaces OMB M-24-18; applies to contracts from solicitations issued 180 days after issuance.
Agencies must update acquisition procedures within 270 days and convene cross-functional teams.
Contracts must prevent vendor lock-in and prohibit using non-public agency data to train commercial AI.
Solicitations must disclose high-impact use cases and transparency/documentation requirements; ongoing independent testing and monitoring required.
Maximize use of American-made AI; GSA to produce procurement guide (100 days) and repository (200 days).
